newsitem.title: USA: Applied Science buys ILC unit.
newsitem.headline: Applied Science buys ILC unit.

text.p: Applied Science and Technology Inc said on Friday it acuired all the assets of Converter Power Inc, a unit of ILC Technology Inc, for $6.35 million in cash and 45,000 shares of Applied Science common stock.
Applied Science shares were up 3/8 to 12-5/8 in early Nasdaq trading on Friday.

Applied Science said it expects the purchase to be accretive to annual earnings, although there will be a non-recurring charge in the fourth quarter for Converter Power's in-process research and development.

Converter Power, of Beverly, Mass., makes customized power supplies for semiconductor capital equipment, medical and industrial lasers and electro-optics. It had revenues of $12.2 million for the fiscal year ending Sept. 28, 1996.
Applied Science makes production technology products for semiconductor, medical and CVD diamond applications.
